com.ibm.cos.v2.core.internal.http

Class RequestExecutionContext

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.ibm.cos.v2.core.internal.http.RequestExecutionContext

  • public final class RequestExecutionContext
extends Object
    Request scoped dependencies and context for an execution of a request by AmazonSyncHttpClient or AmazonAsyncHttpClient. Provided to the RequestPipeline.execute(Object, RequestExecutionContext) method.
